Dulbecco's modified Eagle's medium (DMEM; Gibco, USA) was used to culture the cells, supplemented with 10% fetal bovine serum (FBS; Gibco, USA) and 1% penicillin/streptomycin solution. Plasmids coding for CSNK1D (pTSB-CMV-CSNK1D-copGFP-F2A-PuroR) were designed and purchased from TransheepBio-Tech CO, LTD (Shanghai, China). To overexpress CSNK1D, HepG2 cells were transfected with OE-CSNK1D plasmids or control vector plasmids by Lipofectamine 3000(Invitrogen). Forty-eight hours later, 5 µg/ml of puromycin (Invitrogen) was added to the medium and maintained for another 14 days until the stably-transfected cell lines were established. The sequence of short hairpin RNA(ShRNA) with highest intervening efficacy targeting CSNK1D was CUAUCUCGGUACGGACAUUTTAAUGUCCGUACCGAGAUAGTT. steps.title: Culture HCC cell lines
steps.instruction: Obtain HCC cell lines HepG2 (#SCSP-510, Cell Bank of Chinese Academy of Sciences), Hep3B (#SCSP-5045, same source), BEL‑7404 (#TCHu64, same source), MHCC97H (#ZQ0020, Zhong Qiao Xin Zhou Biotechnology) and HCCLM3 (#ZQ0023, same source). Grow them in Dulbecco's Modified Eagle Medium (DMEM; Gibco, USA) supplemented with 10 % fetal bovine serum (FBS; Gibco, USA) and 1 % penicillin/streptomycin solution, incubating under standard cell‑culture conditions.

steps.title: Transfect HepG2 with CSNK1D plasmid
steps.instruction: Seed HepG2 cells, then transfect them with the CSNK1D overexpression plasmid pTSB‑CMV‑CSNK1D‑copGFP‑F2A‑PuroR (purchased from TransheepBio‑Tech CO, LTD, Shanghai, China) or with a control vector using Lipofectamine 3000 (Invitrogen) according to the manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: Select stable CSNK1D‑overexpressing cells
steps.instruction: Forty‑eight hours after transfection, add puromycin (Invitrogen) to the culture medium at a final concentration of 5 µg ml⁻¹ and continue selection for an additional 14 days to obtain stably transfected HepG2 cell lines.

steps.title: Prepare RNA‑interference reagents
steps.instruction: Record the short hairpin RNA (shRNA) sequence targeting CSNK1D (CUAUCUCGGUACGGACAUUTTAAUGUCCGUACCGAGAUAGTT) and the small interfering RNA (siRNA) sequence targeting DVL3 (GCUCCCUUUCACCAUUUAUAUAAAUGGUGAAAGGGAGC) for use in knock‑down experiments.

steps.title: Perform apoptosis assay
steps.instruction: Using the FITC‑Annexin V Apoptosis Detection Kit (BD Biosciences, USA), suspend cells from each experimental group in binding buffer, add Annexin V‑FITC and incubate for 15 min. After incubation, add propidium iodide (PI) and analyze the samples on a BD FACS Calibur flow cytometer (Becton‑Dickinson, USA).

steps.title: Analyze cell cycle by PI staining
steps.instruction: Treat cells from each group with propidium iodide (PI) solution for 15 min, then detect DNA content using a BD FACS Calibur flow cytometer. Process the data with Modfit software.
